Connect the AI agents on this computer to Cua: install the cua skills and configure the cua MCP server

Usage: cua connect [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  detect  List supported AI coding agents and which are installed (read-only)
  setup   Install the default cua skills and configure the cua MCP server
  status  Whether each agent is really connected: installed and its version, signed in, Cua's MCP entry present and answering, and its sign-in copied to Keyvault. The same rows as the app and the `connect_status` MCP tool
  remove  Remove the Cua Spaces skills and MCP entries cua added (nothing else)
  update  Refresh installed cua skills and managed MCP entries to this version
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --embedded
          Use an embedded runtime even when a daemon runs

      --daemon <DAEMON>
          Daemon address (socket path or loopback URL)
          
          [env: CUA_DAEMON=]

      --daemon-token <DAEMON_TOKEN>
          Daemon token (loopback URLs)
          
          [env: CUA_DAEMON_TOKEN]

      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>
          Sandbox state directory (embedded; default ~/.cua/sandboxes)

      --json
          Print JSON

  -h, --help
          Print help
